Persuade the leaderless undead commanders to return to Palawa Joko's command. Force of arms should provide the best incentive!

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Convince [[Kareh Ossa]]'s commanders to align with Joko by defeating them in combat. You have defeated [0...4] of 4 commanders.
* See [[Palawa Joko]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the quest pointer to each of the commanders in turn and defeat them and their guards. Be careful, since the normal area spawns will also be present making for large mixed groups of enemies. Two commanders can be reached using [[Junundu]], making them easy to defeat.

On the map: W is [[Wurm Spoor]] locations. The numbers are the four commanders.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''General Farrund'''
:''"Kareh Ossa is gone and his forces remain leaderless. If left unchecked, this power vacuum will spur infighting until another warlord takes his place. Now is your chance to assemble the splintered factions at Joko's side. Venture into the '''Alkali Pan''' and face those who would dare stand against Palawa Joko. Crush them in combat and convice these traitors that Palawa Joko's banner is the side with which they should align themselves."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = By your command.
|decline = I don't take my frakkin' orders from you.
|ask = Find Kareh's '''commanders''' and convince them to join you. Use whatever tactics necessary. }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Palawa Joko'''
:''"You did well handling that foolish excuse for a warmarshal, and I am impressed that you managed to do the job with so few casualties! His troops should provide the additional strength I need to protect the palace from any further assaults. It will be secure enough for you to use as a base for your operations. If only [[Turai Ossa|Turai]] could see me now!"''

==Notes==
* The four commanders are: [[Commander Mosek]], [[Commander Yamji]], [[Commander Lohgor]] and [[Commander Giturh]]. Note that while some of them have [[elite skill]]s, they cannot be captured due to the fact that they automatically turn non-hostile if defeated (less than 20% health), preventing their deaths. Also since they do not, technically, die - you do not receive any [[morale boost]]s.
* Should you map back to town to remove any [[death penalty]], you will restart the quest.
* The [[mob]] linked with each commander will become friendly when the commander is defeated, so if you want a fast run, target and take down each commander first.
* The boss group of [[Churkeh the Defiant]] might not [[spawn]] if this quest is active when entering the area.

==Trivia==
*"By your command" is a [[W:Cylon|Cylon]] catchphrase and "frakkin" is a catchall swearword from the [http://en.battlestarwiki.org/wiki/Frak Battlestar Galactica] TV series.
